title: StockSmart Field Service Rate Card — Emergency Visits and Trip Charges
content:
Rate card for unscheduled and cancelled visits under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program.

| Tier | Emergency visits per calendar quarter without the fee | Fee per emergency visit beyond them, USD | Hours of notice below which a customer cancellation carries a trip charge | Trip charge for a visit cancelled late or refused at the gate, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| StockSmart Self-Scan | 0 | 95.00 | 24 | 0.00 |
| StockSmart Monthly Service | 0 | 95.00 | 24 | 95.00 |
| StockSmart Biweekly Service | 1 | 75.00 | 24 | 75.00 |
| StockSmart Weekly Service | 2 | 60.00 | 24 | 60.00 |
| StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service | 4 | 40.00 | 24 | 40.00 |
| StockSmart Onsite Storeroom | 12 | 0.00 | 24 | 0.00 |

### Reading the card

- The emergency visit fee applies per unscheduled emergency visit requested by the customer beyond the tier's included visits for the calendar quarter; a fee of 0.00 is never charged.
- The notice figure is 24 hours on every tier: a scheduled visit the customer cancels with less than 24 hours of notice carries the tier's trip charge, as does a scheduled visit refused at the gate.
- A trip charge of 0.00 (StockSmart Self-Scan, StockSmart Onsite Storeroom) means no trip charge is made.

### Hypothetical example

On a hypothetical StockSmart Weekly Service program, the first and second emergency visits of a quarter fall within the 2 included visits; a third emergency visit in that quarter carries 60.00.
